description: For every list \(s\), \(E(C(s),i)\) is its \(i\)-th entry, with default \(0\) when the index is outside the list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.entry_code (s : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.entry (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code s)
      i =
    s[i]?.getD 0
